name: AutoAssist
tagline: AutoAssist is your smart missed call manager.
description: AutoAssist is your smart missed call manager that automatically replies to calls via SMS when you are busy, driving, riding, or when your phone is in your pocket. Designed for safety and productivity, it evaluates system sensors to detect if you are traveling and auto-replies to keep callers informed.
author: CODEGUYAKASH
features: Default SMS Manager: Seamlessly view, manage, and read your SMS conversations and threads in one clean interface.
Automated Missed Call SMS Reply: Automatically sends your selected SMS reply template whenever an incoming call is missed.
Multi-SIM Support: Select system default SIM or choose a specific SIM card for sending automated replies on dual-SIM devices.
Customizable Templates: Choose from pre-configured reply templates or create your own custom message responses.
Bot Name Prefix Option: Optionally add a customizable assistant name prefix (e.g., [ASSIST_BOT]) to outgoing auto-replies.
Smart Safeguards: Set a daily SMS limit cap and enjoy automatic duplicate-call protection (prevents sending multiple SMS to the same caller within 10 minutes).
Recent Activity Log: Track missed call events, answered calls, auto-SMS dispatch timestamps, and delivery statuses.
On-Device Privacy: All processing happens locally on your device. Your call logs, contact details, and SMS data remain strictly private and are never uploaded to any external server.

name: Dev Launcher
tagline: Dev Launcher is a clean, distraction-free. Launcher
description: Dev Launcher is a clean, distraction-free Android launcher built for developers and productivity users who want a pure, minimal home screen experience.
author: CODEGUYAKASH
features: Minimal home screen — show only your favorite apps.
Full app drawer with fast alphabetical scroll.
Grid or list layout for the app drawer.
Monochrome app icons (black/light theme · white/dark theme).
Real-time clock widget with battery indicator.
Dynamic dark/light/system theme support.
Haptic feedback toggle for battery saving.
Quick shortcuts to Battery, Device Settings, and About Phone.
Favorite apps — long-press any app to pin it.
App info and uninstall from long-press context menu.
Zero permissions — no internet, no location, no contacts.
R8-optimized for minimal battery and RAM usage.
